verdict.summary: The host admission/commitment mirror and the Noir relation consistently enforce the load-bearing invariants: committed rule shapes, range restriction, grounded join premises, canonical integer operand binding, whitelisted builtins, and terminal-root binding. The negative tests exercise real forgery paths rather than mocks, including uncommitted-rule substitution, an unbound conclusion variable, absent graph leaves, ungrounded premises, false/relabelled builtin operands, invalid rule indices, and root mismatch. The extracted signed-integer helpers preserve the FILTER binding and verdict behavior, and the documentation keeps the feature explicitly research-grade, unmeasured, undispatched, and not externally audited. No hostile reviewer-directed instruction was present in the diff.
